US-linked consumer demand (+0.66%) provides a hedge for Indonesian exporters, but local purchasing power remains the swing factor for mass-market staples.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap FMCG names riding the IDX momentum wave, but lock gains fast—this is a liquidity-driven squeeze, not fundamentals. Rotate into BEER and AMMS for beer/glass exposure with volume confirmation; avoid chasing SSTM/BIKE at +25% without earnings proof. Trim into strength by Friday, keep core in staples with US-linked demand.
